definitions.coverage: A timed row establishes only that record. Missing team reports and completeness remain unknown.
definitions.key_conflict: Same season/week/team/GSIS and normalized modification clock with differing non-clock fields.
definitions.non_qb: Offense/defense positions excluding QB, K, P and LS; unknown positions counted separately.
definitions.non_qb_all_positions: All rows except QB, including separately excluded special teams and unknown positions.
definitions.timing_precedence: Unmatched scheduled game; missing clock; invalid clock; at or after T-60; valid timestamp.
definitions.valid_timestamp: Nonmissing aware date_modified strictly before scheduled T-60; not proof of historical source publication.

Eight season blocks give limited uncertainty information; intervals are diagnostic, not scenario confidence ranges.
Issued forecasts and the active corrected fit remain unchanged. EXPERIMENTAL / HOLD.
